topic: The one question that reveals your teen's natural hustle
caption:
Ask your teen this one question tonight: 'What can you do that most kids your age can't?'

Their answer might surprise you. That skill — editing videos, fixing bikes, walking dogs, tutoring math — is worth real money to real neighbors.

You don't need to push them. You just need to help them see what's already there.

Give them a head start → hustleup.us
